scripts.infra: docker compose up -d postgres redis rabbitmq localstack jaeger
scripts.infra:local: docker compose up -d --wait postgres redis rabbitmq localstack jaeger
scripts.infra:down: docker compose stop postgres redis rabbitmq localstack jaeger
scripts.app:down: docker compose stop api-gateway-service order-catalog-service inventory-service payment-service frontend
scripts.dev:local: yarn infra:local && yarn app:down && concurrently -k -n api,order,inventory,payment,front -c cyan,green,magenta,yellow,blue "yarn dev:local:api" "yarn dev:local:order" "yarn dev:local:inventory" "yarn dev:local:payment" "yarn dev:local:frontend"
scripts.dev:local:api: cross-env PORT=18080 ORDER_SERVICE_URL=http://localhost:13000 ORDER_SERVICE_WS_URL=http://localhost:13000 INVENTORY_SERVICE_URL=http://localhost:13001 PAYMENT_SERVICE_URL=http://localhost:13333 OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:4318/v1/traces npm.cmd --prefix ./api-gateway-service run dev:local
scripts.dev:local:order: cross-env PORT=13000 DB_HOST=localhost DB_PORT=5432 DB_USER=root DB_PASS=password DB_NAME=order_catalog_db DATABASE_URL=postgresql://root:password@localhost:5432/order_catalog_db?schema=public REDIS_HOST=localhost REDIS_PORT=6379 RABBITMQ_URL=amqp://admin:admin@localhost:5672 AWS_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:4566 AWS_PUBLIC_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:4566 AWS_REGION=us-east-1 AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=test AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=test S3_BUCKET_PRESCRIPTIONS=click-prescriptions OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:4318/v1/traces npm.cmd --prefix ./order-catalog-service run dev:local
scripts.dev:local:inventory: cross-env PORT=13001 DB_HOST=localhost DB_PORT=5432 DB_USER=root DB_PASS=password DB_NAME=inventory_db DATABASE_URL=postgresql://root:password@localhost:5432/inventory_db?schema=public REDIS_HOST=localhost REDIS_PORT=6379 RABBITMQ_URL=amqp://admin:admin@localhost:5672 OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:4318/v1/traces npm.cmd --prefix ./inventory-service run dev:local
scripts.dev:local:payment: cross-env PORT=13333 DB_HOST=localhost DB_PORT=5432 DB_USER=root DB_PASS=password DB_NAME=payment_db DATABASE_URL=postgresql://root:password@localhost:5432/payment_db?schema=public REDIS_HOST=localhost REDIS_PORT=6379 RABBITMQ_URL=amqp://admin:admin@localhost:5672 OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:4318/v1/traces npm.cmd --prefix ./payment-service run dev:local
scripts.dev:local:frontend: cross-env VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:18080 VITE_WS_URL=http://localhost:18080 npm.cmd --prefix ./frontend run dev:local
scripts.dev: docker compose up -d --build && yarn deps:sync && yarn db:push && yarn migrate
scripts.deps:sync: docker compose up -d --build api-gateway-service order-catalog-service inventory-service payment-service frontend && docker compose exec -T api-gateway-service npm install && docker compose exec -T order-catalog-service npm install && docker compose exec -T inventory-service npm install && docker compose exec -T payment-service npm install && docker compose exec -T frontend npm install && docker compose restart api-gateway-service order-catalog-service inventory-service payment-service frontend
scripts.db:push: docker compose exec -T order-catalog-service sh -lc "npx prisma db push || echo 'order-catalog-service: prisma db push skipped (legacy schema)'" && docker compose exec -T inventory-service sh -lc "npx prisma db push || echo 'inventory-service: prisma db push skipped'" && docker compose exec -T payment-service sh -lc "npx prisma db push || echo 'payment-service: prisma db push skipped'"
scripts.db:reset:prisma: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d postgres redis rabbitmq localstack jaeger && docker compose up -d --build order-catalog-service inventory-service payment-service && yarn deps:sync && yarn db:push
scripts.migrate: docker compose exec -T payment-service sh -lc "if [ -d prisma/migrations ] && find prisma/migrations -mindepth 1 -print -quit | grep -q .; then npm run prisma:deploy; else echo 'payment-service: no migrations, skipping'; fi"
